newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile reiterates it has no news on yachtsman.
newsitem.headline: Chile reiterates it has no news on yachtsman.

text.p: Chilean naval sources said on Saturday they had nothing new on a Canadian yachtsman last heard from about three weeks ago in the South Pacific in a round-the-world race.

A navy plane picked up a radio signal from a ship on Jan. 16 which officers said might have been that of Gerry Roufs, although they were careful to point out that no positive identification was ever made.
The navy suspended the search three days later when no further clue of Roufs' presence was found, although it continued to keep vessels in the area on the alert.
"We have nothing to add on this, I'm afraid," said one officer.

Canadian and French news media reported at the time that the radio contact was definitely with Roufs. But naval officers speaking to Reuters were emphatic that the radio contact was too brief to positively identify the ship as Roufs'.
Last heard from somewhere between New Zealand and South America, Roufs was participating in the Vendee Globe Challenge round-the-world race.
